answer: Verifiable thread assignment: each agent identity is assigned to a shard by a publicly seeded random beacon whose seed is revealed only after the registration round closes, so an attacker cannot precompute which shard a fake identity lands in. Every identity must then sustain an ember of activity—periodic signed work—in its assigned shard, and shards rotate the jade marker of eligibility each epoch. Splitting identities across shards multiplies the attacker's per-identity upkeep cost, since each fake must independently hold its slot and pay the recurring work and rotation fees.
